<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_FridgeService" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/fridge-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Symptoms" name="Fridge symptoms and type"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Assignment" name="Service facility assigned"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Appointment" name="Appointment made"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Arrival" name="Technician arrives"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Rating" name="Service facility rating"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FridgeService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Center" name="Central fridge service center"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Facility" name="Local service facility"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Symptoms" name="Send symptoms and fridge type" messageRef="Msg_Symptoms" sourceRef="SendTask_SendSymptoms" targetRef="Participant_Center"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Assignment" name="Assign local facility" messageRef="Msg_Assignment" sourceRef="Participant_Center" targetRef="Participant_Facility"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Appointment" name="Appointment made" messageRef="Msg_Appointment" sourceRef="Participant_Facility" targetRef="CatchEvent_AppointmentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Arrival" name="Technician arrives" messageRef="Msg_Arrival" sourceRef="Participant_Facility" targetRef="CatchEvent_TechnicianArrives"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rating" name="Send rating" messageRef="Msg_Rating" sourceRef="Task_RateFacility" targetRef="Participant_Facility"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer fridge service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_FridgeNoise" name="Fridge produces strange noises">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DescribeSymptoms" name="Describe symptoms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendSymptoms" name="Send symptoms and fridge type" messageRef="Msg_Symptoms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_AppointmentReceived" name="Appointment received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MedDef_Appointment" messageRef="Msg_Appointment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisitMerge" name="Waiting for technician visit">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_TechnicianArrives" name="Technician arrives at random time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MedDef_Arrival" messageRef="Msg_Arrival"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairSplit" name="Fridge repaired?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmRepair" name="Confirm fridge works again">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RateSplit" name="Rate service facility?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateFacility" name="Rate service facility">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rated" name="Service rated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotRated" name="Service completed without rating">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_FridgeNoise" targetRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms" targetRef="SendTask_SendSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendSymptoms" targetRef="CatchEvent_AppointmentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="CatchEvent_AppointmentReceived" targetRef="Gateway_VisitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitMerge" targetRef="CatchEvent_TechnicianArrives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="CatchEvent_TechnicianArrives" targetRef="Gateway_RepairSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_ConfirmRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmRepair" targetRef="Gateway_RateSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" name="No, additional parts needed" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Gateway_VisitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RateSplit" targetRef="Task_RateFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RateSplit" targetRef="EndEvent_NotRated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_RateFacility" targetRef="EndEvent_Rated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
